_about: Public-domain Warren Fay (1784-1864), Congregational minister of Charlestown, Massachusetts, for the Word Hoard: his funeral, ordination and missionary sermons (1812-1835), including Obligations of Christians to the Heathen World and The Importance of the Last Promise of Jesus Christ to Christian Missionaries. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 106 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wfay-funeral-ely: A sermon, delivered July 17, 1812, in Monson, at the funeral of Mrs. Nancy Ely, wife of the Rev. Alfred Ely, who died July 15th, in the 34th year of her age (Printed by Peter B. Gleason, )
wfay-ordination-cogswell: A sermon, delivered April 24, 1822, at the ordination of the Rev. Nathanael Cogswell, as colleague pastor of the Congregational church and society in Yarmouth, Mass (Boston : Crocker & Brewster, Printers, 1822)
wfay-ordination-1822: A Sermon, Delivered January 1, 1822, at the Ordination of the Rev. Joseph Bennet [i.e. Bennett (Crocker & Brewster , printers ..., 1822)
wfay-obligations-heathen: Obligations of Christians to the heathen world. A sermon delivered at the Old South Church in Boston, before the Auxiliary Foreign Mission Society of Boston and vicinity, at their annual meeting, January 3, 1825 (Boston [Mass.]: Printed by Crocker and Brewster .., 1825)
wfay-last-promise: Importance of the last promise of Jesus Christ to Christian missionaries. A sermon, delivered at Springfield, May 10, 1826, at the ordination of the Rev. Rufus Anderson, as an evangelist, and of the Rev. Messrs. Josiah Brewer, Eli Smith, Cyrus Stone, and (Boston [Mass.]: Printed by Crocker & Brewster .., 1826)
